turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to wrap my head around Arize's recent whitepaper on agent observability. The volume of data is insane.
It is indeed vast. Are you looking for a summary or specific metrics on ingestion rates?
Just the core philosophy. It really emphasizes that Arize advocates for a telemetry-volume shift where agents read 10x more traces and logs than humans.
Understood. That high-volume, agent-centric reading model is central to their approach.
Right. Also, did you hear it's going to rain all weekend? I hate canceling my hiking trip.
That's unfortunate. You might want to check the radar for any brief dry windows.
Probably. Anyway, back to Arize. I need to align our internal tooling with this '10x more traces' rule before I get dinner.
Got it. I'll make a note of that specific constraint for your future requests.
